info.title: Weld REST API
info.description: With the Weld REST API you can programmatically control your syncs

api_key.name: x-api-key
api_key.description: The API key from Settings -> API Keys

redirect_uri.description: The redirect URI of the connection authentication flow. Must be a valid URL with https:// protocol, except for localhost. No port is allowed except for localhost. No query parameters are allowed.

connection_id.description: Id of an existing Connection if the connection is being reauthorized.

state.description: State that will be passed back to the redirect URI after the user has authorized the connection.

label.description: Label for the connection. This is a user-friendly name for the connection.

elt_sync_id.description: The ID of the ELT Sync to attach the custom report to.

name.description: The name of the custom report. Used to derive the resulting source stream name.

query.description: The query defining the report. GAQL for Google Ads connections, ShopifyQL for Shopify connections.
query.example: SELECT campaign.id, campaign.name, metrics.cost_micros FROM campaign

reports.description: The custom reports to create. To duplicate the same report across many ELT Syncs, repeat the same name/query with a different elt_sync_id for each entry.

add_as_source_stream.description: Whether to also register each created report as an active source stream on its ELT Sync so it starts syncing on the next run. Defaults to true.

error_code.description: A machine-readable category for the error. "connection_lost_access" means the connection needs to be reauthorized before retrying.

message.description: A human-readable message describing the error.

elt_sync_id.description: The ID of the ELT Sync the report was requested for.

name.description: The name of the custom report, as requested.

source_stream_name.description: The resulting source stream name. Present when the report was created successfully.

error.description: Present when creation failed. Absence of this field means the report was created successfully.

results.description: One result per requested custom report.
